title: epipactis helleborine var. youngiana
intro: Epipactis helleborine var. youngiana, commonly known as Helleborine Orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Europe, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis helleborine var. youngiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
